parameters.query:
with base as (
  select p.id, p.nome, p.preco, e.saldo, nullif(p.imagem_url, '') as img
  from bling_produtos p
  join (select produto_id, sum(saldo_fisico) as saldo
        from bling_estoque group by produto_id) e on e.produto_id = p.id
  where p.situacao = 'A'
    and e.saldo > 0
    and (nullif($2::text, '') is null or p.preco <= nullif($2::text, '')::numeric)
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(string_to_array(lower(trim($1::text)), ' ')) as w
      where length(w) > 2
        and translate(lower(p.nome), 'áàâãäéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüç', 'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuuc')
            not like '%' || translate(w, 'áàâãäéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüç', 'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuuc') || '%'
    )
),
grupos as (
  select
    (array_agg(id order by preco, id))[1]    as id,
    (array_agg(nome order by preco, id))[1]  as nome,
    min(preco)                               as preco,
    (array_agg(saldo order by preco, id))[1] as saldo,
    bool_or(img is not null)                 as tem_foto,
    case when count(*) > 1 then
      json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'nome', nome, 'preco', preco, 'saldo', saldo) order by preco)
    end as variacoes
  from base
  group by coalesce(img, id::text)
)
select coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) as produtos
from (
  select id, nome, preco, saldo, tem_foto, variacoes
  from grupos
  order by
    case when nullif($2::text, '') is null then preco end asc,
    case when nullif($2::text, '') is not null then preco end desc
  limit 20
) x;
